in_scope.name: Hakim
in_scope.other_work: I am the person everyone calls about computers at our mosque. I set up the projector and the sound system before each talk. I installed the wifi network there and I keep its password safe. When the office PC gets slow or full of pop-ups I clean it up. Last month I set up a new printer for the office.

in_scope.name: Farah
in_scope.other_work: At my aunt's travel agency I look after the office network and the five PCs. I create email accounts for new staff and remove them when people leave. When the internet slows down I check the router to see what is using it. I keep Windows and the antivirus updated on every machine. I wrote short guides so the staff can fix small problems themselves.

in_scope.name: Kumar
in_scope.other_work: I repair laptops and phones for people in my block of flats. I replace broken screens, batteries and keyboards. When a laptop gets a virus I reinstall Windows and the programs. I test every repaired laptop properly before I hand it back. I keep a notebook of each repair and the parts I used.

in_scope.name: Aisyah
in_scope.other_work: I run the website for my family's batik business. I upload product photos and update the prices and descriptions every week. I changed the page layout so it works well on phones. I set up the online payment page and check that orders come through. I look at the site's visitor numbers to see which products people view.

in_scope.name: Irfan
in_scope.other_work: I build small websites for friends' businesses with HTML, CSS and JavaScript. I wrote a booking app in Python for my brother's barber shop. When customers report a bug I find it and fix it. I use Git to keep track of my changes. I test each new page on phones before it goes live.

in_scope.name: Tan
in_scope.other_work: I volunteer as a tester for an open-source game. I write test cases for each new feature and run them on every release. I report bugs with clear steps so the developers can reproduce them. I check that each fix works and that nothing else broke. I wrote Python scripts that run the basic checks automatically.

in_scope.name: Lina
in_scope.other_work: I made a mobile app for my university club that shows event times and rooms. I designed the screens on paper first and then in Figma. The app keeps its data in a small online database. I keep improving it based on what members ask for. I showed the committee how to add new events themselves.

in_scope.name: Nurul
in_scope.other_work: I do the bookkeeping for my mother's catering business. I record every sale and every expense in a spreadsheet. At the end of each month I match the bank statement with our records. I prepare her yearly accounts for the tax return. I also work out what each dish costs us so she can set her prices.

in_scope.name: Daniel
in_scope.other_work: Each month I run an online survey for my church youth group and analyse the answers in Excel. I clean up the survey data before I start. I make charts for the committee and explain what the numbers mean. I keep the membership list up to date in a shared sheet. I use simple statistics to compare this year's answers with last year's.

in_scope.name: Siti
in_scope.other_work: At weekends I help my uncle's credit cooperative check loan applications. I look at members' payslips and bank statements to see if they can repay. I calculate the monthly instalments for each loan. I explain the repayment terms to members before they sign. I keep a record of who is behind on payments and remind them.

in_scope.name: Arjun
in_scope.other_work: I manage a small share portfolio for my family and track how each company is doing. I read the annual reports before we buy anything. I compare the returns and fees of different funds for my parents' retirement savings. I keep a spreadsheet of every trade and dividend. I explain the risks to my parents before they decide.

in_scope.name: Mei Ling
in_scope.other_work: Every April I prepare tax returns for neighbours and relatives. I collect their pay slips and receipts and check that nothing is missing. I work out their reliefs and the tax they owe or get back. I submit the returns online for them. I keep copies of everyone's papers in labelled folders.

out_of_scope.name: Rosnah
out_of_scope.other_work: I bake cakes and cookies to order from home. I take orders through WhatsApp and agree the price. I buy the ingredients at the market each morning. I decorate birthday cakes the way customers ask. I deliver the orders in my car.

out_of_scope.name: Ravi
out_of_scope.other_work: I look after my grandmother at home in the evenings. I help her bathe and get dressed. I give her medicine at the right times. I take her to her clinic appointments. I cook soft meals she can eat.

out_of_scope.name: Zul
out_of_scope.other_work: I help my uncle renovate houses at weekends. I lay floor tiles and mix the cement. I paint the walls and ceilings. I fix leaking pipes under the sinks. I carry materials up to the upper floors.
